Mountain Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe)

Philadelphia, PA · Wissahickon / East Falls · Mountain bike

When
Every Saturday, 8:00 amSaturdays, 8:00 am, 10 miles of the Orange, White and Yellow trails in Wissahickon Valley Park. The Trellis calendar says dates alternate, so confirm with the shop.
Starts at
PAPERtrail Bike Cafe, 211 Lincoln Dr, Philadelphia, PA 19144 Map ↗

10 miles

Checked Oct 2, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host’s page before you go

How we know

The shop’s Espresso Rides page says Mountain Espresso Saturday at 8am, 10 miles of Wissahickon trails (undated page), and The Trellis’s October 2026 calendar lists ‘PAPERtrail Mountain Espresso, dates alternate’ (both read Oct 2, 2026).

Hosted by
PAPERtrail Bike CafeBike shop
Kind of ride
Mountain bike

For visitors

The shop rents full-suspension Salsa mountain bikes. Free espresso at the shop after the ride.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Intermediate and advanced riders are encouraged; regulars lead and sweep. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @papertrailbikecafe the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mountain Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe) group ride

Mountain Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe) is a mountain bike group ride in Philadelphia, PA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from PAPERtrail Bike Cafe.

A Saturday morning mountain bike ride in Wissahickon Valley Park from the PAPERtrail Bike Cafe. The shop calls it a no-drop ride with regulars to lead and sweep, and gives free espresso back at the shop.
